name: security-scanner
description: A self-improving adversarial security scanner for KiroCrew. Splits each scan into focused topics that run as parallel agents, validates findings with sandboxed proof-of-concept exploits against an isolated pod, and learns from every scan — confirmed exploits become tagged patterns and false positives become suppressions. Ships with three high-signal topics: path traversal, auth bypass, and prompt injection.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Decomposes each scan into narrow security topics that run as parallel agents
Each topic agent gets only its tagged knowledge slice — focused context, no pollution
Validates findings with real proof-of-concept exploits against an isolated pod, never the live gateway
Learns from every scan: confirmed exploits become patterns, false positives become suppressions
Ingests external security reports (CVE, Semgrep, pentest) into the tagged knowledge base
Findings are never auto-filed — the scanner reports, you decide what to act on
Ships three high-signal topics for KiroCrew: path traversal, auth bypass, prompt injection

crons.name: security-scanner-scan
crons.message: Run a scheduled security scan by invoking the security-scan skill against the KiroCrew codebase for all active topics (path-traversal, auth-bypass, prompt-injection). Persist findings and notify only on NEW actionable findings. Read SECURITY_NOTES.md first — exploit PoCs run only against an isolated pod, never the live gateway.
